verdict.rationale: No Copilot API is documented, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The only non-UI surfaces are an official CLI for using Copilot from the terminal, event- and schedule-triggered automations for the cloud agent, and assigning work via @copilot mentions. These give some programmatic access but show nothing close to full UI parity. Missing for 10: a documented public Copilot API or OpenAPI spec, evidence that UI features (chat, agent sessions, code review, model selection, settings) are all reachable programmatically, and independent confirmation of parity.
